lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sequence of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns, specifically three to four primary nodes visible per vertical section posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible running from the posterior gill region toward the caudal section, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal aspect and lower values on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five identifiable commensal fish (remoras) swimming in the immediate proximity of the ventral flank and pectoral fin trailing edge.
